values.value: when does my assessment close;how long does the assessment take;assessment timeline;how long until decision;turnaround;SLA

Once an Assignment is Accepted by a practitioner, the Assessment has a 15-business-day window to reach "Pending Review". After the Assessor signs off, decision is typically within 5 further business days. Timelines reset if additional documents are requested. You can see the exact dates on the Assessment record.
